import os, glob
import pandas as pd

candidates = []
for root in [".", "/mnt/data", "/content", "data", "/home", "/tmp"]:
    if os.path.exists(root):
        for p in glob.glob(os.path.join(root, "**", "*"), recursive=True):
            if os.path.isfile(p) and os.path.splitext(p)[1].lower() in {
                ".csv",".tsv",".json",".jsonl",".parquet",".xlsx",".xls",".feather",".orc",".txt",".yaml",".yml"}:
                candidates.append(p)

print("Data files:", sorted(set(candidates)) or "NONE")
print("DataFrames:", {k: v.shape for k, v in globals().items() if isinstance(v, pd.DataFrame)} or "NONE")
print("Sidecars/schema docs: NONE")
